verdict.rationale: LightSprint says its background cloud agents can clear a bug backlog. Tasks can be created from Slack, Linear or Jira, and each runs in an isolated full-stack sandbox. The agent builds the change from a plain-English description and opens a PR with tests and typecheck readiness signals, so the core autonomous bug-fix loop is claimed. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how the agent diagnoses a bug (reproduction, root-cause analysis, log or trace inspection), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous bug fixing.
